messages.subject: LR Linearity Test
parts:
Dear D. Stigler,

first of all thank you very much for developing such a beautiful and useful package!

Here goes my question/trouble:

I have two price series for which I estimated both a VECM and a (M)TAR model.

Due to non-significant results for the (M)TAR model, I stick to the VECM for interpreting price transmission dynamics between the two series.

Consequently, I am asked to run a linearity test that could justify the "rejection" of non-linear models, therefore I used the TVAR.LRtest command. However, the warning message "the thDelay values do not correspond to the univariate implementation in tsdyn" prevents R to run it.

Could you please help me out? I tried many different thDelay but no one worked so far. I don't understand what the warning is about though.

Thank you in advance,

Best Regards

Federico
